context_map.exchanged_information: Ingress Packets with 1Hz telemetry samples from edge devices, bike computers and wearables
context_map.boundary_protection: Device payloads are translated into Telemetry Samples at the entry point; device-specific formats never leak inward; no blocking I/O, backpressure applied

context_map.direction: Telemetry Ingestion & Validation -> Telemetry Stream Reconciliation
context_map.exchanged_information: TelemetrySampleValidated and TelemetrySampleValidationFailed events carrying Telemetry Samples with validation status and t_device
context_map.boundary_protection: Only versioned validation events cross; Sensor Metric Boundary definitions stay internal; failed samples are tagged, never dropped

context_map.direction: Telemetry Ingestion & Validation -> Telemetry Event Store
context_map.exchanged_information: TelemetrySampleValidated and TelemetrySampleValidationFailed events with raw samples and validation status
context_map.boundary_protection: Consumes the published validation events only; store never re-validates; records appended as-is

context_map.direction: Telemetry Stream Reconciliation -> Telemetry Event Store
context_map.exchanged_information: TelemetryBackfillReordered events identifying late samples to append as Event Revisions
context_map.boundary_protection: Reorder window internals stay private; store appends new revisions, never mutates existing records

context_map.exchanged_information: TelemetryWindowEmitted ordered windows for streaming analytics consumers
context_map.boundary_protection: Backpressure-aware broadcast of ordered windows only; ingress timestamps and buffers not exposed

cross_boundary_flows.notes: Validation precedes any downstream propagation; consumers must be idempotent; backpressure signals flow upstream.

cross_boundary_flows.business_process: Reorder late packets within 60s backfill window
cross_boundary_flows.notes: Ordering by t_device; corrections appended as revisions. Flagged ambiguity: handling of packets later than 60s is unspecified (assumed revision appended by store); TelemetryRevisionAppended has no consumer in this slice.
